description: Development Pipeline - Current is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of London. Records all sites of new buildings and refurbishments over 1000 sq m in the development pipeline at the time of the last development survey (end of March/September). More detail provided in the Development Info report. Contact Monitoring & Information team for further details. Coverage: City of London. The portal files it under the publisher City of London. Its tags are City of London, Development Monitoring, Development Pipeline, Development Pipeline Current. The portal shows 2024-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
